name: Replit Agent
freeTierNote: Starter tier with daily Agent credits.
bestFor: Building and hosting a small app without a local toolchain
skipIf: You already have a serious local environment and a production host
keyFeatures: Live preview URL in one tab
Runs on modest laptops and Chromebooks
limitations: Compute costs scale separately from agent fees
Harder to justify for mature production repos
summary: Browser IDE plus agent plus hosting. Excellent for students and spikes. Awkward as a long-term production home.
body: Replit’s agent is convincing because the result runs in the same tab. For a student in Lahore on a weak laptop, that matters more than Cursor’s desktop install. For a production SaaS, you will outgrow the platform story. Price the compute, not only the Core subscription ($20/mo monthly or $18/mo annual).
notes: Export early so you are not trapped
Not a cracked cloud IDE. Pay or use the free quota.
